summary: We transform the complex world of space missions into an enternatining and educating experience.Thanks to the 2D game we developed, the players achieve a vision about travelling to Mars.The comedy game we developed takes part in 2128, and literally has a World can't be lived in because of drought, and that was why humans travelled to Mars in the first place.Our character, however, is the sole human being left on the planet Earth and tries to reach the rest of the humanity by himself.Everything must be according to real physics and mechanics.
details: In our project, while everyone else has left for space, one person remains on Earth—and we are essentially playing through a simulation of their experiences. Set in the year 2100, the world is a barren, inhospitable wasteland—the result of nuclear war and climate change—where the protagonist scavenges for remnants left behind by those who departed for space. Some of these items are still functional, while others are broken; the player must collect raw materials to repair the damaged components, eventually using them to construct a rocket. Every step of the design process must be executed with precision; if a mistake is made, the rocket will explode upon liftoff, with the specific animation of the blast reflecting the nature of the error. Once the rocket leaves orbit, it sheds certain stages—just as in a real-world space mission—and during the journey to Mars, the player encounters various challenges. These require solutions chosen from a list of options or through interactive gameplay, with each choice subtly altering the unfolding narrative. The player is even tasked with calculating the rocket's launch thrust—using a provided formula—to ensure the settings are correct. Finally, the player must manage the orbital trajectory for the landing on Mars; if successful, the protagonist, Ömercik, touches down safely on the Red Planet and reunites with his family.
